title: Secluded Log Cabin 8 Acres Sleeps 8 Near Nashville
description:
Secluded log cabin on 8 private acres just 30 minutes from Nashville! Sleeps 8 with 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, plus a bonus room featuring a daybed with trundle. Enjoy peaceful woodland views, abundant wildlife, modern amenities, and plenty of space to relax. Perfect for families, couples, girls' trips, and anyone looking for a quiet Tennessee retreat close to city attractions.

The space
Our cabin is tucked away on 8 peaceful, wooded acres, where deer, wild turkeys, foxes, and other wildlife often wander through the woods and near the cabin. It’s a tranquil, nature-filled escape perfect for slowing down and reconnecting with the outdoors.

Brand-new cabin
3 bedrooms + bonus room
Sleeps 8
Fully equipped kitchen
Modern amenities
8 private acres
Peaceful setting

Other things to note
Conveniently located, our cabin is just 5 minutes from I-24, making it easy to get here and explore the area. We’re only 20 minutes from the beautiful Cumberland River—perfect for fishing, kayaking, or a scenic day out. For quick essentials, Dollar General is just 2 minutes away, and you’ll find a Walmart less than 25 minutes from the cabin.
